research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Arista Networks is researching advanced data center and cloud networking, focusing on switch and access point behavior, configuration, and monitoring. Works like Synchronization of the quality of service configuration within a cluster of network devices and Achieving consistency in overlay data models transactions with a network device address consistent QoS and model-driven configuration. Other efforts such as Policy enforcement in a network using distributed stateless enforcement and Traffic Handling for EVPN E-Tree target scalable routing, security, and EVPN services, defining R&D in software-driven switching, automation, and visibility.

overview_description.description: Arista Networks is a computer networking firm delivering cloud networking solutions for large data center and computer environments. It was founded to deliver software-driven cloud networking solutions for large data center and high-performance computing environments. With more than three million cloud networking ports being deployed worldwide, Arista delivers a portfolio of 1/10/40 and 100 GbE products that redefine network architectures, bring extensibility to networking, and dramatically change the price/performance of data center networks.
